ex.en: Her paper was published in a medical journal.
ex.zh: 她的論文刊登在一份醫學期刊上。

ex.en: Scientists read journals to keep up with new research.
ex.zh: 科學家閱讀期刊以掌握最新研究。

ex.en: My dad keeps a journal every day.
ex.zh: 我爸爸每天都寫日記。

ex.en: Do you keep a journal?
ex.zh: 你記日記嗎？

ex.en: I jog in the morning.
ex.zh: 我早上會去慢跑。

ex.en: He may be jogging around the park.
ex.zh: 他可能正在公園附近慢跑。

ex.en: I think jogging is good exercise.
ex.zh: 我認為慢跑是很好的運動。

ex.en: The man next door said he goes for a jog every morning.
ex.zh: 隔壁的男士說他每天早上都去慢跑。

ex.en: Let's go for a jog after work.
ex.zh: 下班後我們去慢跑吧。

jog.zh: jog one's memory：喚起某人的記憶

ex.en: This photo might jog your memory.
ex.zh: 這張照片也許能喚起你的記憶。

ex.en: Let me jog your memory: we met at last year's conference.
ex.zh: 我提醒你一下：我們去年在研討會上見過。

ex.en: Tom studies journalism in Boston.
ex.zh: 湯姆在波士頓念新聞系。

ex.en: She has worked in journalism for ten years.
ex.zh: 她在新聞業工作了十年。

ex.en: They worked jointly on this project.
ex.zh: 他們一起進行過這個專案。

ex.en: Euro 2012 is being hosted jointly by Poland and Ukraine.
ex.zh: 2012 年歐洲盃足球賽由波蘭和烏克蘭共同主辦。

ex.en: The account is jointly owned by Tom and Amy.
ex.zh: 這個帳戶由 Tom 和 Amy 共同持有。

ex.en: Today, many people worry about losing their jobs.
ex.zh: 如今很多人擔心失業。

ex.en: Tom is thinking about applying for a better-paying job.
ex.zh: 湯姆正在考慮應徵一份薪水更高的工作。

ex.en: There are many jobs available in the computer industry.
ex.zh: 電腦產業有很多工作機會。

ex.en: Give us the tools, and we'll finish the job.
ex.zh: 給我們工具，我們就能完成工作。

ex.en: Cleaning the kitchen is my job.
ex.zh: 打掃廚房是我的工作。

job.zh: good job / do a great job：做得好

ex.en: Good job on the presentation!
ex.zh: 簡報做得很好！

ex.en: You did a great job.
ex.zh: 你做得非常好。

ex.en: Sam joined the army when he was eighteen.
ex.zh: 山姆十八歲時從軍。

ex.en: There's no membership fee for joining.
ex.zh: 加入不用繳會費。

ex.en: Would you like to join our team?
ex.zh: 你想加入我們的團隊嗎？

ex.en: It is a pity that you can't join us.
ex.zh: 你不能跟我們一起來，真可惜。

ex.en: Do you mind if I join you for lunch?
ex.zh: 我可以跟你一起吃午餐嗎？

ex.en: The bridge joins the two towns.
ex.zh: 這座橋連接兩個城鎮。

ex.en: Join the two pieces with glue.
ex.zh: 用膠水把兩片黏在一起。

ex.en: We are going on a journey next month.
ex.zh: 我們下個月要去旅行。

ex.en: Their journey was delayed because of the train.
ex.zh: 他們的旅程因為火車而延誤了。

ex.en: I made use of the maps during my journey.
ex.zh: 我在旅途中用了地圖。

ex.en: My joints ache when it gets cold.
ex.zh: 天氣變冷時，我的關節會痛。

ex.en: Swimming is good for your joints.
ex.zh: 游泳對關節很好。

ex.en: The two companies launched a joint project.
ex.zh: 兩家公司推出了一項合作專案。

ex.en: We opened a joint bank account.
ex.zh: 我們開了一個聯名銀行帳戶。

ex.en: They formed a joint venture in Vietnam.
ex.zh: 他們在越南成立了一家合資企業。

ex.en: The joint venture will start production next year.
ex.zh: 這家合資企業明年將開始生產。

ex.en: I like the way she laughs at my jokes.
ex.zh: 我喜歡她聽我講笑話時笑的樣子。

ex.en: We were all greatly amused by his jokes.
ex.zh: 我們都被他的笑話逗得很開心。

ex.en: Mr Smith always begins his lectures with a joke.
ex.zh: 史密斯先生總是用一個笑話開始他的課。

ex.en: Tell her that I am just joking with her.
ex.zh: 告訴她我只是在跟她開玩笑。

ex.en: You must be joking! I can't find my passport!
ex.zh: 不會吧！我的護照不見了！

ex.en: At last, they experienced the joy of victory.
ex.zh: 最後，他們嘗到了勝利的喜悅。

ex.en: He could not help jumping for joy at the good news.
ex.zh: 他聽到那個好消息，高興得跳了起來。

ex.en: Language learning brings a lot of joy in our life.
ex.zh: 學語言為我們的生活帶來許多樂趣。

joy.zh: 樂事、令人開心的人事物

ex.en: A thing of beauty is a joy forever.
ex.zh: 美好的事物是永恆的喜悅。

ex.en: It's a joy to work with such a great team.
ex.zh: 能和這麼棒的團隊共事真是一大樂事。

joining.zh: 參加、加入（join 的現在分詞／動名詞）

ex.en: They will not accept any excuses for not joining the meeting.
ex.zh: 他們不接受任何不出席會議的藉口。

ex.en: There's no membership fee for joining.
ex.zh: 加入不用繳會費。

ex.en: Thank you for joining us on today's call.
ex.zh: 謝謝大家參加今天的電話會議。

ex.en: I want to be a journalist.
ex.zh: 我想成為記者。

ex.en: My boyfriend is a journalist.
ex.zh: 我男朋友是個記者。

ex.en: Mr Tani is not so much a scholar as a journalist.
ex.zh: 谷先生與其說是學者，不如說是新聞工作者。

ex.en: There's a job opening in our marketing department.
ex.zh: 我們行銷部有一個職缺。

ex.en: I saw the job opening on the company's website.
ex.zh: 我在公司網站上看到這個職缺。

ex.en: The two firms established a joint venture in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 兩家公司在台灣成立了一家合資企業。

ex.en: The joint venture will develop new medical equipment.
ex.zh: 這家合資企業將開發新的醫療設備。
